quote_timing.interpretation: The public indicator card refreshes quotes periodically rather than maintaining an observed WebSocket stream.

confirmed_regression.signature: [ChartStore] settings.chart.timeToCloseLabel is a required field; settings.chart.style.lineSource is a required field; settings.chart.style.tpo is a required field

risk_findings.title: ChartStore initializes with missing required fields
risk_findings.causal_chain: page bootstrap -> partial persisted/default chart settings -> schema validation failure -> chart continues in degraded state
risk_findings.evidence: The same error appears once during first initialization and once immediately after reload.

risk_findings.title: No explicit stale/offline state during quote interruption
risk_findings.causal_chain: network interruption -> last chart remains visible -> no stale/offline label observed -> user may treat an old quote as current
risk_findings.evidence: The public chart preserved the visible BTC series during a five-second offline interval without an observed disconnected, stale, delayed, or offline marker.

risk_findings.title: Public quote updates use periodic ListQuotes polling
risk_findings.causal_chain: timer -> ListQuotes -> changed binary quote body -> chart state
risk_findings.evidence: Five quote calls and four distinct quote bodies were observed; no WebSocket connection was observed.

risk_findings.title: Historical backfill and candle-layer integrity require an unobstructed interactive run
risk_findings.causal_chain: horizontal pan -> older range request -> ordered bar merge -> stable candle and indicator layers
risk_findings.evidence: The cookie-consent surface contaminated interaction evidence; no fix or defect claim is made.
